Chapter 02 — Powertrain

The 390 CID Big-Block V8

Under the sculpted steel hood beats the heart of an American street terror: the Ford FE 390 cubic-inch V8 fed by an Autolite four-barrel carburetor, producing effortless low-end torque.

325BHP
Peak Horsepower

Rated at 4,800 RPM with hydraulic lifters and free-breathing cylinder heads.

427LB-FT
Gross Torque

Available from 3,200 RPM, delivering immediate off-the-line velocity.

6.5SEC
0 – 60 MPH

Tested with the heavy-duty 4-speed manual transmission and 3.25:1 axle.

10.5:1CR
Compression Ratio

High-compression combustion chambers tuned for premium performance fuel.

Engineering Masterpiece

  • Deep-Skirt Cast Iron Block: Reinforced webbing designed to withstand extreme track punishment.
  • Dual Exhaust with Chrome Quad Tips: Unrestricted flow releasing the thunderous big-block resonance.
  • Heavy-Duty Toploader 4-Speed: Bulletproof manual gearbox with positive mechanical gate engagement.
